blocks.zh: 導論與背景
blocks.en: Introduction and Background

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解人因工程 (Human Factors) 的定義，以及為什麼 FDA 對組合產品特別關注使用相關風險
blocks.en: Understand the definition of Human Factors (HF) and why FDA pays particular attention to use-related risk in combination products

blocks.zh: 掌握本指引的適用範圍：哪些產品類型、哪些申請類型受到涵蓋
blocks.en: Grasp the scope of this guidance: which product types and which application types are covered

blocks.zh: 了解組合產品的法規定義 (21 CFR Part 3) 及其監管架構
blocks.en: Understand the regulatory definition of a combination product (21 CFR Part 3) and its regulatory framework

blocks.zh: 理解 HF 指引在藥品與醫療器材雙重要求下的定位
blocks.en: Understand where the HF guidance sits under the dual drug and device requirements

blocks.zh: 識別 FDA 草案指引的法律地位：非強制性建議，但代表 FDA 當前思維
blocks.en: Recognize the legal status of an FDA draft guidance: non-binding recommendations, but a reflection of FDA's current thinking

blocks.zh: 從 CDMO 角度，了解為何即使不擁有器材設計，也需掌握 HF 驗證邏輯
blocks.en: From a CDMO perspective, understand why HF validation logic matters even when you do not own the device design

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 導論第一段
blocks.en: Commentary — Introduction, Paragraph 1

blocks.zh: Human Factors (HF) 人因工程是什麼？
blocks.en: What Are Human Factors (HF)?

blocks.zh: HF 是研究「人」如何與「產品」互動的科學，核心目標是讓產品在真實使用情境下——包括壓力、光線不足、使用者知識有限的情況——仍能被正確、安全地使用。
blocks.en: HF is the science of how people interact with products. Its core goal is that a product can still be used correctly and safely under real-world conditions, including stress, poor lighting and users with limited knowledge.

blocks.zh: 對組合產品而言，HF 不只是設計美學，而是法規要求的安全驗證程序。
blocks.en: For combination products, HF is not a matter of design aesthetics; it is a regulatory-required safety validation process.

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 3 — 組合產品定義來源
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 3 — Source of the Combination Product Definition

blocks.zh: 美國聯邦法規第 21 編第 3 部分規範了組合產品的定義與分類。本指引以此為基礎，明確了 HF 研究的適用對象。
blocks.en: Title 21, Part 3 of the US Code of Federal Regulations sets out the definition and classification of combination products. This guidance builds on it to make clear which products HF studies apply to.

blocks.zh: 比喻：User Interface 就像汽車的儀表板
blocks.en: Analogy: The User Interface Is Like a Car Dashboard

blocks.zh: 一輛性能卓越的車，如果儀表板設計混亂、換檔桿位置不直覺，駕駛仍可能發生事故。同理，即使藥物本身有效，若自動注射器設計不良，患者可能無法成功給藥。
blocks.en: Even a high-performance car can have accidents if the dashboard is confusing and the gear shift is not intuitively placed. Likewise, even if the drug itself is effective, a poorly designed autoinjector may prevent patients from successfully administering the dose.

blocks.zh: User interface = 使用者操作組合產品時所接觸的一切：外觀、標籤、操作步驟、回饋機制。
blocks.en: User interface = everything the user touches when operating the combination product: appearance, labeling, operating steps and feedback mechanisms.

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 適用範圍
blocks.en: Commentary — Scope of Application

blocks.zh: FDA 三大中心 × 組合產品
blocks.en: FDA's Three Centers × Combination Products

blocks.zh: 組合產品依主要作用模式 (PMOA) 分配至主要審查中心：
blocks.en: Combination products are assigned to a lead review center according to their primary mode of action (PMOA):

blocks.zh: CDER：藥品為主導（如預填式注射器、自動注射器）
blocks.en: CDER: drug-led (e.g., prefilled syringes, autoinjectors)

blocks.zh: CBER：生物製品為主導（如生物製劑給藥裝置）
blocks.en: CBER: biologic-led (e.g., biologic delivery devices)

blocks.zh: CDRH：器材為主導（如藥物塗層支架）
blocks.en: CDRH: device-led (e.g., drug-coated stents)

blocks.zh: 無論分配到哪個中心，HF 要求都同樣適用。
blocks.en: Regardless of which center is assigned, the HF requirements apply equally.

blocks.zh: 注意：510(k) 與 ANDA 也可能適用
blocks.en: Note: 510(k) and ANDA May Also Apply

blocks.zh: FDA 明確說明，本指引原則「可適用」於 510(k)（仿製器材）和 ANDA（仿製藥）組合產品。若設計改變可能影響 HF，應主動諮詢 OCP。
blocks.en: FDA states explicitly that the principles in this guidance "may apply" to 510(k) (device) and ANDA (generic drug) combination products. If a design change could affect HF, consult OCP proactively.

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 相關指引與法律地位
blocks.en: Commentary — Related Guidance and Legal Status

blocks.zh: Office of Combination Products (OCP) 的角色
blocks.en: The Role of the Office of Combination Products (OCP)

blocks.zh: OCP 是 FDA 內部協調組合產品審查的辦公室，負責：
blocks.en: OCP is the FDA office that coordinates the review of combination products. It is responsible for:

blocks.zh: 決定組合產品應由哪個中心主導審查
blocks.en: Determining which center should lead the review of a combination product

blocks.zh: 協調 CDRH (器材 HF 專業) 與 CDER/CBER (藥品法規主導) 的溝通
blocks.en: Coordinating communication between CDRH (device HF expertise) and CDER/CBER (drug regulatory lead)

blocks.zh: 接受廠商對 HF 研究適用性的諮詢
blocks.en: Accepting sponsor inquiries on the applicability of HF studies

blocks.zh: 重要：草案指引 ≠ 法律要求
blocks.en: Important: Draft Guidance ≠ Legal Requirement

blocks.zh: 本文件是 2016 年 2 月發布的「草案指引」(Draft Guidance)，代表 FDA 當時的思維，但：
blocks.en: This document is a draft guidance issued in February 2016. It represents FDA's thinking at that time, but:

blocks.zh: 非強制性法規 (not legally binding)
blocks.en: It is not a binding regulation (not legally binding)

blocks.zh: "Should" = 建議，非 "must" 或 "shall"
blocks.en: "Should" = recommendation, not "must" or "shall"

blocks.zh: 可能因意見徵集後修訂
blocks.en: It may be revised after public comments are considered

blocks.zh: 即便如此，監管機構在審查時會參考此框架，廠商若無充分理由偏離，面臨的審查風險依然存在。
blocks.en: Even so, regulators refer to this framework during review, and a sponsor that deviates without sound justification still faces review risk.

blocks.zh: 比喻：指引如同「FAA 飛行建議」
blocks.en: Analogy: Guidance Is Like "FAA Flight Advice"

blocks.zh: 飛行員不一定非遵守 FAA 每一項 Advisory Circular，但如果發生事故，未遵守建議就很難自圓其說。FDA 指引的邏輯相似：非強制，但偏離需要充分理由。
blocks.en: A pilot is not strictly required to follow every FAA Advisory Circular, but after an accident it is hard to justify not having followed the advice. FDA guidance works in a similar way: it is not mandatory, but any deviation needs sound justification.

blocks.zh: 兩份關鍵參考指引
blocks.en: Two Key Reference Guidances

blocks.zh: HF 器材指引 (2016)：Applying Human Factors and Usability Engineering to Optimize Medical Device Design — 通用 HF 方法論基礎
blocks.en: HF device guidance (2016): Applying Human Factors and Usability Engineering to Optimize Medical Device Design — the general HF methodology foundation

blocks.zh: 藥品安全設計指引 (草案)：Safety Considerations for Product Design to Minimize Medication Errors — 藥品側的使用錯誤預防
blocks.en: Drug safety-in-design guidance (draft): Safety Considerations for Product Design to Minimize Medication Errors — prevention of use errors on the drug side

blocks.zh: 本組合產品 HF 指引建立在這兩份文件之上，整合器材與藥品雙重視角。
blocks.en: This combination product HF guidance builds on these two documents and integrates both the device and drug perspectives.

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 背景：組合產品定義
blocks.en: Commentary — Background: Definition of Combination Products

blocks.zh: 組合產品的四種組合形式
blocks.en: The Four Combination Forms of Combination Products

blocks.zh: 藥品 + 器材（如：預填式注射器、吸入器）
blocks.en: Drug + device (e.g., prefilled syringes, inhalers)

blocks.zh: 器材 + 生物製品（如：細胞治療給藥裝置）
blocks.en: Device + biological product (e.g., cell therapy delivery devices)

blocks.zh: 生物製品 + 藥品（如：混合製劑）
blocks.en: Biological product + drug (e.g., mixed formulations)

blocks.zh: 藥品 + 器材 + 生物製品（三方組合）
blocks.en: Drug + device + biological product (three-way combination)

blocks.zh: 最常見的是第一類：自動注射器、PFS（預填式針筒）、胰島素筆、吸入器。
blocks.en: The most common is the first type: autoinjectors, PFS (prefilled syringes), insulin pens and inhalers.

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：組合後，各成分仍保留其監管地位
blocks.en: Key Principle: After Combination, Each Constituent Part Retains Its Regulatory Status

blocks.zh: 自動注射器中的藥液仍是「藥品」，注射器本體仍是「醫療器材」。因此，組合產品同時受到藥品法規（CGMP 21 CFR Part 211）和器材法規（QSR 21 CFR Part 820）的管轄。
blocks.en: The drug solution in an autoinjector is still a "drug", and the injector body is still a "medical device". A combination product is therefore governed by both drug regulations (CGMP, 21 CFR Part 211) and device regulations (QSR, 21 CFR Part 820).

blocks.zh: 這就是 HF 研究對組合產品特別複雜的原因：需同時滿足兩套要求。
blocks.en: This is why HF studies are particularly complex for combination products: two sets of requirements must be met at the same time.

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 器材成分的 HF 法規要求
blocks.en: Commentary — HF Regulatory Requirements for the Device Constituent Part

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 820.30：器材設計控制要求
blocks.en: 21 CFR 820.30: Device Design Control Requirements

blocks.zh: FDA 器材品質系統法規（QSR）第 820.30 條規定「設計驗證」(design validation) 必須涵蓋適當的風險分析。人因工程研究即是這個風險分析過程的重要組成。
blocks.en: Section 820.30 of FDA's device Quality System Regulation (QSR) requires that "design validation" include appropriate risk analysis. Human factors studies are an important part of that risk analysis process.

blocks.zh:
設計控制的核心邏輯：
識別使用相關危害 → 分析風險 → 設計改善 → 驗證設計有效
blocks.en:
Core logic of design controls:
Identify use-related hazards → analyze risk → improve the design → validate that the design is effective

blocks.zh: Use-Related Hazards（使用相關危害）的定義
blocks.en: Definition of Use-Related Hazards

blocks.zh: 不是器材本身的缺陷，而是「使用者操作不當」所造成的危害，例如：
blocks.en: These are hazards caused not by a defect in the device itself but by "improper operation by the user", for example:

blocks.zh: 自動注射器針帽難以移除 → 患者使用時用力過猛受傷
blocks.en: The autoinjector needle cap is hard to remove → the patient uses excessive force and is injured

blocks.zh: 劑量顯示視窗不清楚 → 患者誤判劑量
blocks.en: The dose display window is unclear → the patient misreads the dose

blocks.zh: 啟動按鈕位置不直覺 → 注射中途中斷
blocks.en: The activation button is not intuitively placed → the injection is interrupted midway

blocks.zh: 廢棄物處理設計不良 → 針刺傷風險
blocks.en: Poorly designed waste disposal → risk of needlestick injury

blocks.zh: 比喻：HF 就像「使用場景的壓力測試」
blocks.en: Analogy: HF Is a "Stress Test of the Use Scenario"

blocks.zh: 工廠品管測試藥品在 40°C/75%RH 下的穩定性；HF 則是測試「在真實使用條件下」——患者顫抖的手、昏暗的燈光、緊張的情緒——器材是否仍能被正確操作。
blocks.en: Factory quality control tests drug stability at 40°C/75%RH; HF tests whether the device can still be operated correctly "under real use conditions", with a patient's trembling hands, dim lighting and anxiety.

blocks.zh: 兩者都是對「極端條件」的驗證，只是壓力源不同。
blocks.en: Both verify performance under "extreme conditions"; only the source of stress differs.

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 藥品成分的 HF 期望
blocks.en: Commentary — HF Expectations for the Drug Constituent Part

blocks.zh: 藥品側的使用錯誤預防機制
blocks.en: Use Error Prevention Mechanisms on the Drug Side

blocks.zh: 對藥品而言，HF 不只是器材介面，而是整個使用鏈的設計：
blocks.en: For drugs, HF is not just the device interface but the design of the entire use chain:

blocks.zh: 配方選擇：黏度影響注射難易度
blocks.en: Formulation selection: viscosity affects ease of injection

blocks.zh: 容器封閉系統：針帽材質、拔除力道
blocks.en: Container closure system: needle cap material and removal force

blocks.zh: 標籤設計：字型大小、對比度、易混淆藥名警示
blocks.en: Label design: font size, contrast, warnings for easily confused drug names

blocks.zh: 包裝配置：多劑量 vs. 單劑量，避免過量風險
blocks.en: Packaging configuration: multi-dose vs. single-dose, to avoid overdose risk

blocks.zh: 命名法：避免 LASA（look-alike, sound-alike）藥名混淆
blocks.en: Nomenclature: avoiding LASA (look-alike, sound-alike) drug name confusion

blocks.zh: 相關 ICH 指引連結
blocks.en: Links to Related ICH Guidelines

blocks.zh: 本段引用了三份 ICH 指引：
blocks.en: This section cites three ICH guidelines:

blocks.zh: ICH Q8(R2)：藥品開發 — 配方設計質量依據
blocks.en: ICH Q8(R2): Pharmaceutical Development — basis for formulation design quality

blocks.zh: ICH Q9：品質風險管理 — 使用風險評估框架
blocks.en: ICH Q9: Quality Risk Management — framework for use risk assessment

blocks.zh: ICH Q10：藥品質量體系 — 組織架構支持 HF 活動
blocks.en: ICH Q10: Pharmaceutical Quality System — organizational structure supporting HF activities

blocks.zh: PDUFA IV 的政策意義
blocks.en: Policy Significance of PDUFA IV

blocks.zh: PDUFA IV 將「前瞻性設計降低使用者錯誤」列為藥品開發目標之一。這意味著 HF 不只是器材業界的議題——FDA 期望藥廠在設計藥品時，就將使用安全性納入考量，而非等到上市後再處理召回。
blocks.en: PDUFA IV listed "proactive design to reduce user error" as one of the goals of drug development. This means HF is not only a device-industry issue: FDA expects drug companies to build use safety into product design from the start, rather than dealing with recalls after launch.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務角度：容器封閉系統影響 HF
blocks.en: CDMO Practice Perspective: The Container Closure System Affects HF

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO，填充組合產品時，以下製程參數直接影響 HF 驗證結果：
blocks.en: As a CDMO filling combination products, the following process parameters directly affect HF validation results:

blocks.zh: 填充量精確度：影響劑量顯示窗的可讀性
blocks.en: Fill volume accuracy: affects the readability of the dose display window

blocks.zh: 矽化量 (silicone coating)：影響活塞滑動力，進而影響注射操作力道
blocks.en: Silicone coating level: affects plunger glide force and therefore the force needed to inject

blocks.zh: 針帽拔除力：容器封閉完整性測試與 HF 驗證的交叉點
blocks.en: Needle cap removal force: the intersection of container closure integrity testing and HF validation

blocks.zh: 可提取物 / 浸出物 (E&L)：若影響配方黏度，可能連帶影響注射難易度
blocks.en: Extractables / leachables (E&L): if they alter formulation viscosity, they may in turn affect ease of injection

blocks.zh: CDMO 即使不擁有器材設計，製程改變也可能觸發客戶的 HF 重新驗證需求。
blocks.en: Even if a CDMO does not own the device design, a process change can trigger the customer's need for HF revalidation.

blocks.zh: 中文解說 — 雙重要求的整合
blocks.en: Commentary — Integrating the Dual Requirements

blocks.zh: 核心原則：器材要求 + 藥品要求 = 同時適用
blocks.en: Core Principle: Device Requirements + Drug Requirements = Both Apply at the Same Time

blocks.zh: 組合產品同時受到：
blocks.en: A combination product is subject to both:

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 820.30（器材設計控制）— 要求 HF 作為設計驗證的一部分
blocks.en: 21 CFR 820.30 (device design controls) — requires HF as part of design validation

blocks.zh: PDUFA IV / ICH Q8-Q10（藥品開發框架）— 要求前瞻性使用安全設計
blocks.en: PDUFA IV / ICH Q8-Q10 (drug development framework) — requires proactive use-safety design

blocks.zh: 這兩套要求不互相替代，而是疊加在同一個組合產品上。這正是本指引存在的原因：幫助廠商理解如何在一個 HF 計劃中同時滿足兩者。
blocks.en: These two sets of requirements do not replace each other; they are layered on the same combination product. This is why the guidance exists: to help sponsors understand how to satisfy both within a single HF program.

blocks.zh: HF 研究的目的層次
blocks.en: Hierarchy of HF Study Objectives

blocks.zh: 消除 (eliminate) 使用相關危害 — 最理想，透過設計根本解決
blocks.en: Eliminate use-related hazards — the ideal, solved at the root through design

blocks.zh: 緩解 (mitigate) 使用相關危害 — 無法消除時，降低嚴重度或發生率
blocks.en: Mitigate use-related hazards — when elimination is not possible, reduce severity or occurrence

blocks.zh: 殘餘風險告知 — 透過標籤、使用說明書、培訓材料
blocks.en: Communicate residual risk — through labeling, instructions for use and training materials

blocks.zh: HF 驗證研究的目的，就是確認設計是否已達到「消除或有效緩解」使用相關危害的目標。
blocks.en: The purpose of an HF validation study is to confirm that the design has achieved the goal of "eliminating or effectively mitigating" use-related hazards.

blocks.zh: 比喻：HF 驗證如同「臨床前安全試驗 + 使用者場景」
blocks.en: Analogy: HF Validation Is Like "Nonclinical Safety Studies + User Scenarios"

blocks.zh: 藥品需要毒理研究確認安全劑量範圍；組合產品還需要 HF 驗證確認「在目標使用者手中，能否在真實使用場景中達到治療目的，且不造成額外危害」。
blocks.en: A drug needs toxicology studies to confirm its safe dose range; a combination product also needs HF validation to confirm that, "in the hands of the intended users, it can achieve its therapeutic purpose in real use scenarios without causing additional harm".

blocks.zh: 兩者都是上市申請的必要組成，缺一不可。
blocks.en: Both are essential components of a marketing application, and neither can be omitted.

blocks.zh: CDMO 策略建議：了解客戶的 HF 計劃
blocks.en: CDMO Strategy Recommendation: Understand the Customer's HF Plan

blocks.zh: CDMO 在承接組合產品填充業務時，應主動詢問客戶：
blocks.en: When taking on combination product filling work, a CDMO should proactively ask the customer:

blocks.zh: HF 驗證是否已完成，或尚在進行中？
blocks.en: Is HF validation complete, or still in progress?

blocks.zh: 我們的製程規格（如活塞力道、填充量公差）是否影響已完成的 HF 驗證？
blocks.en: Do our process specifications (e.g., plunger force, fill volume tolerance) affect the HF validation already completed?

blocks.zh: 若製程改變，客戶是否需要重新進行 HF 研究？（可能觸發補充申請）
blocks.en: If the process changes, does the customer need to repeat the HF study? (This may trigger a supplement.)

blocks.zh: 客戶是否需要我們提供容器封閉系統的 HF 相關測試數據？
blocks.en: Does the customer need us to provide HF-related test data on the container closure system?

blocks.zh: 提前了解這些問題，可避免後期的商業風險和法規延誤。
blocks.en: Understanding these questions early avoids later commercial risk and regulatory delay.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一個預填式自動注射器 (autoinjector with PFS) 同時含有藥品和器材成分。請說明它在 FDA 審查下，哪些法規要求與 HF 有關？（提示：考慮 21 CFR 820.30 和藥品開發要求）
blocks.en: A prefilled autoinjector (autoinjector with PFS) contains both drug and device constituent parts. Explain which regulatory requirements are relevant to HF in FDA's review. (Hint: consider 21 CFR 820.30 and the drug development requirements.)

blocks.zh: FDA 草案指引中使用 "should" 而非 "shall"，這在法規溝通上意味著什麼？廠商是否可以完全不遵守？
blocks.en: FDA's draft guidance uses "should" rather than "shall". What does this mean in regulatory communication? Can a sponsor ignore it entirely?

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO，你的客戶要求你確認矽化量改變是否會影響 HF 驗證。請說明矽化量如何與 HF 相關，以及你會如何回應客戶？
blocks.en: As a CDMO, your customer asks you to confirm whether a change in silicone coating level will affect HF validation. Explain how silicone level relates to HF and how you would respond to the customer.

blocks.zh: OCP（Office of Combination Products）在組合產品 HF 審查中扮演什麼角色？何時應主動聯繫 OCP？
blocks.en: What role does OCP (Office of Combination Products) play in HF review of combination products? When should you proactively contact OCP?
